help.title: Help
help.metaDescription: Learn how to use Code Printer. Guides on features like page breaks, margin controls, find and replace, and more.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started: Your First Step with Code Printer
gettingStarted.intro: Code Printer is a tool designed to help developers print or convert source code into clean, well-formatted documents. All your code is processed entirely within your browser and is never sent to our servers, ensuring your data remains secure.

screenLayout.title: Screen Layout
screenLayout.editorDesc: The left pane. Paste or write your code here.
screenLayout.previewDesc: The right pane. It shows a real-time preview of how your code will be printed.
screenLayout.controlsDesc: Located at the top of each pane, these allow you to control various features.

basicUsage.title: Basic Usage (3 Steps)
basicUsage.step1: Paste your code into the left editor.
basicUsage.step2: Use the control panel above the right preview to adjust the style (font, size, margins, etc.) to your liking.
basicUsage.step3: Click the 'Print' button to save as a PDF or send it to your printer.

editor.title: Using the Code Editor
editor.highlightingDesc: Supports various programming languages and automatically detects the language to make your code visually appealing.
editor.findReplaceDesc:
Beyond simple text search, it supports multi-line search and replace using the newline character (
), which is useful for refactoring.
editor.quickCleanDesc: Handle common code cleanup tasks like 'Remove Consecutive Empty Lines' or 'Lift Closing Brackets' with a single click.
editor.undoRedoDesc: Don't be afraid of making mistakes. You can revert to a previous state at any time, as it remembers up to 50 of your past actions.

style.title: Style Settings:
style.font: Using a monospaced font designed for coding (like D2Coding, Consolas) prevents code alignment issues and improves readability.
style.size: Adjust the font size, letter spacing, and line height to create the most readable format. Code that is too dense is hard to understand.

paper.title: Paper Settings:
paper.columns: 1-column is a standard document format, while 2-column is useful when you have a large amount of code or want to create a two-column layout like in a research paper.
paper.margins: We provide 'Default', 'None', and 'Minimum' presets, and you can precisely adjust margins in mm with the custom option.

pageBreak.title: Page Break System
pageBreak.autoDesc: The preview shows where pages will automatically break based on A4 paper size and your current style settings.
pageBreak.manualDesc: Use the 'Page Break' button in the editor to force a page break wherever you want. This prevents important functions or classes from being split across pages and helps you group code into logical units to enhance the final output.

bestResults.title: Print Settings for Best Results
bestResults.marginsDesc: In your browser's print dialog, set the margins to 'None' or 'Minimum' to ensure the margins you set in the app are applied correctly.
bestResults.backgroundDesc: You must enable this option to print the syntax highlighting colors from the editor. (In Chrome, this is under 'More settings'.)

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.layoutBroken: The layout looks broken in the print preview:
troubleshooting.layoutBrokenDesc: Please double-check that the 'Margins: None' setting is applied.
troubleshooting.colors: The colors are not showing up correctly:
troubleshooting.colorsDesc: Please ensure the 'Background Graphics' option is enabled.

security.title: Data Security
security.desc: Your code is valuable. This service does not send your code to a server or store it in a database. All processing is done exclusively within your web browser, so you can use it with peace of mind.

about.title: About Code Printer
about.metaDescription: Learn about the mission and features of the Code Printer project. See how we're dedicated to providing the best code printing experience for developers.

alert.removeFirstChar: Removed the first character from all lines.

preview.printInstruction: For the best results, please set the margins to 'None' or '0' in your browser's print dialog.

header.siteTagline: Print your source code cleanly, efficiently, and securely.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Read the Privacy Policy for Code Printer. Learn about the information we collect, its purpose, and our cookie policy when you use our service.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.p1: This service (code-printer) may automatically collect the following information to improve user convenience and maintain service quality:
section1.item3: Service usage records such as IP address, browser type, and device information
section1.p2: This information is non-identifying and does not specify an individual.

section2.title: 2. Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information
section2.p1: This service uses the collected information for the following purposes:
section2.item1: Providing personalized ads through third-party ad providers like Google AdSense
section2.item2: Analyzing service usage statistics and improving quality

section3.title: 3. Information Collection by Cookies
section3.p1: This service may allow third-party ad providers, including Google AdSense, to use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to your website or other websites.
section3.p2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to your users based on their visit to your sites and/or other sites on the Internet.
section3.p3: Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting <1>Google Ad Settings</1>. Alternatively, users can opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting <3>www.aboutads.info/choices</3>.

section4.title: 4. Changes to the Privacy Policy
section4.p1: Any additions, deletions, or corrections to the policy due to changes in laws and regulations will be notified through an announcement at least 7 days before the changes take effect.

section5.title: 5. Contact
section5.p1: For inquiries regarding personal information or service suggestions, please submit an issue on our GitHub repository.
